text: EU AI Act — measured compliance with Regulation 2024/1689 | CSOAI Home Products ProvBench Article 43 Article 50 Passport FAQ EU AI Act — measured compliance with Regulation 2024/1689 The EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689) is the EU's harmonised rules for AI. CSOAI measures compliance on published harnesses — 417 statutory provisions crosswalked across EU, UK and US — and signs every result so it can be verified independently. Sub-pages EU AI Act — Summary — the one-page overview of the regulation's structure. EU AI Act — Compliance — how CSOAI measures compliance and what the evidence looks like. EU AI Act — Risk — Article-by-article walk of the risk-classification system. EU AI Act — High-Risk — Annex III and the high-risk systems obligations. What we measure Article 50 — transparency obligations for AI systems interacting with people. Free signed passport . Article 43 — internal-control conformity assessment for most Annex III systems. The internal-control route, with evidence . Provenance survival — does a marking actually survive real-world transforms? ProvBench (0 of 20 embedded manifests survived any measured transform; sidecar 100%). Closed-book citation — can the system correctly cite the relevant provision when asked? AI Act frozen-split harness . What we do not do We do not certify. We measure. A regulator certifies. We do not replace notified bodies where the law requires them. We do not assert "compliance" — we publish measured results on a published harness. Boundary Nothing on this site is legal advice. The MCP harnesses and signed records are evidence; the legal interpretation is its own layer (notified bodies, regulators, counsel). We make the evidence layer cheaper and verifiable; the legal layer is its own layer. CSOAI Ltd · UK company 16939677 · Every published figure traces to a signed, verifiable record.

register.note: CSOAI measures and publishes evidence. It issues no conformity marks and holds no accreditation. Nothing here is certification or legal advice.
